title: A three-manifold without conjugate points or nonpositive curvature

result.label: A three-manifold without conjugate points or nonpositive curvature
result.statement: Constructs a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold that admits a metric without conjugate points but no metric of nonpositive sectional curvature. This answers negatively, already in dimension three, whether the first metric-existence property implies the second.
